bridge.label: bridge
bridge.tip: metal decks, cables and lights over the chasm (levels 00-03)

olive.tip: 05 Gateway: olive drab checkpoint, warm khaki haze

paved.label: Paved areas
paved.tip: open floor inside these boxes is paved all over (plazas, courtyards, yards) instead of road with pavement round it

metal.label: Metal rooms
metal.tip: inside these boxes the floor, walls and chasms are the metal (bridge) kit, with a metal lining into the walls round them: lab rooms dug into the level (09 Complex)

rock.label: rock
rock.tip: badlands of dirt, gravel and rock over a concrete bunker (levels 08-)

interior.label: Bunker interior
interior.tip: inside these boxes the floor is bunker concrete and the walls bunker walls with a coped roof; outside is badlands ground and rock

concrete.label: Concrete walls
concrete.tip: walls inside these boxes out in the badlands are drawn as concrete (pillboxes, huts) instead of rock

metal.label: Metal rooms
metal.tip: inside these boxes the floor, walls and chasms are the metal (bridge) kit, with a metal lining into the walls round them: lab rooms dug into the level (09 Complex)
